English: Clay Pit

A rough, hand-dug clay pit from which the clan gathers the raw earth needed for pottery. Essential for even the simplest wares, it fosters the beginnings of a pottery tradition and helps draw nomads together for shared labor.
Potters Wheel

Simple wooden wheels and crude workbenches, easily assembled and transported, allow the clans artisans to shape clay more efficiently. This marks a leap in both the scale and quality of pottery, drawing more hands to the craft.
Kiln Hut
A primitive hut of earth and timber shelters the clans first permanent kiln. This allows the firing of more durable wares and simple storage vessels, vital for nomadic logistics and supply.
Pottery Pavilion
A large, tented pavilion where several potters can work and teach apprentices. It centralizes production, fosters community, and begins to attract traders from afar.
Glazers Room

Constructed after the discovery of glazing techniques, this tented chamber allows for the creation of vibrant, water-resistant wares. Fine pottery, now more valuable, becomes a source of clan pride and lucrative trade.
Fine Pottery Hall
A semi-permanent wooden structure lined with tapestries, this hall showcases the very best of Slavic pottery. It is a center for clan gatherings, rituals, and trade negotiations.
Market Booth
Pottery and wares are displayed at a dedicated market booth on trade routes, drawing travelers and merchants. The booth increases trade and clan visibility in the region.
Guild Pavillion

A grand tented meeting hall, the center of the Potters’ Guild, where the most skilled artisans gather to share knowledge, set prices, and oversee apprenticeships. Its influence extends across the region.
Master Potters Chamber
A fortified wooden chamber reserved for the master potter, holding the clans most precious patterns and trade secrets. The chamber is a symbol of prestige and attracts ambitious artisans from afar.
West Slavic Pottery Guild

A permanent, prestigious institution representing the height of West Slavic nomadic craftsmanship. The Guild regulates trade, certifies masters, and acts as a diplomatic hub for the clan, greatly enhancing its wealth and unity.
